args.text: CREATE TABLE T (ID COUNTER CONSTRAINT PK_T PRIMARY KEY, Code TEXT(10) CONSTRAINT UX_T_Code UNIQUE, L LONG, D DOUBLE, C CURRENCY, Dt DATETIME, S TEXT(50), M MEMO, B LONGBINARY, Y YESNO, Sh SHORT, Bt BYTE, Sg SINGLE, G GUID)
INSERT INTO T (Code, L, D, C, N, Dt, S, M, Y, Sh, Bt, Sg) VALUES ('a1', 10, 1.5, 2.25, 3.125, #2024-01-02#, 'alpha', 'memo one', True, 7, 200, 1.5)
INSERT INTO T (Code, L, D, C, N, Dt, S, M, Y, Sh) VALUES ('b2', 20, -0.5, 0, 0, #2024-03-04 12:00:00#, 'Beta', '', False, 0)
INSERT INTO T (Code, L, D, C, N, Dt, S, M, Y) VALUES ('c3', 30, 0, 1234.5678, -0.0001, #1999-12-31#, 'gamma', 'x', True)
INSERT INTO T (Code, L, D, S) VALUES ('d4', 20, 2.5, 'alpha')
INSERT INTO T (Code, L, S) VALUES ('f6', 50, 'it''s')
INSERT INTO T (Code, L, S) VALUES ('g7', 5, '')
SELECT B FROM T WHERE Code = 'a1'
CREATE TABLE W (ID LONG CONSTRAINT PK_W PRIMARY KEY, Code TEXT(10) CONSTRAINT UX_W_Code UNIQUE, V LONG, V2 LONG, S TEXT(20))
CREATE TABLE P (ID LONG CONSTRAINT PK_P PRIMARY KEY, Nm TEXT(10))
CREATE TABLE Ch (ID LONG CONSTRAINT PK_Ch PRIMARY KEY, PID LONG CONSTRAINT FK_Ch_P REFERENCES P (ID), S TEXT(10))
PARAMETERS pL Long; SELECT ID, Code, L FROM T WHERE L = pL;
PARAMETERS pS Text(50), pI Long; UPDATE T SET S = pS WHERE ID = pI;
SELECT ID, Code, L, S FROM T ORDER BY ID;
